# 1Digit

> 1Digit is a UK-based software, data and AI consultancy that helps enterprises design, build, and govern structured AI systems, data platforms, and architecture frameworks.

1Digit works with enterprise organisations to move from fragmented data estates to production-grade AI capability. We combine assessment-first methodology, TOGAF-aligned architecture, and proprietary platform technology to deliver measurable outcomes — not proof-of-concept theatre.

Founded on the principle that AI must be architected, not assembled, 1Digit provides end-to-end delivery from strategy through to production, with governance built in from day one.

## Services

- [AI Readiness & Honest Assessment](https://1digit.co.uk/what-we-do): Capability benchmarking across five pillars, executive workshops, risk analysis, and 6-18 month transformation roadmaps. Typical engagement: 2-5 weeks.
- [Data & Platform Foundations](https://1digit.co.uk/data-platforms): Data unification, ingestion design, Smart Lakehouse architecture, observability, and cost-efficient cloud design. Typical engagement: 6-16 weeks.
- [AI-Enabled Products & Engineering](https://1digit.co.uk/what-we-do): AI-native application design, agent integration, guardrails, evaluations, and production readiness. Typical engagement: 8-20 weeks.
- [AI Architecture, Governance & Secure Implementation](https://1digit.co.uk/architecture): TOGAF-grounded enterprise AI architecture, risk frameworks, compliance alignment, role-based access controls, and AI Ops support. Typical engagement: 4-12 weeks.

## Platforms

- [Tachyon](https://1digit.co.uk/tachyon): High-throughput enterprise data activation platform. Unifies fragmented data, detects sensitivity, enforces structure, and makes data immediately usable for analytics, AI, and operational systems.
- [Smart Lakehouse on IONOS](https://1digit.co.uk/smart-lakehouse-ionos): Enterprise data lakehouse on European sovereign cloud. 40-60% lower infrastructure cost than hyperscaler equivalents, with full data sovereignty.

## Methodology

- [How We Work](https://1digit.co.uk/how-we-work): Four-phase methodology — Diagnose, Design, Deliver, Embed — with clear gates, commercial checkpoints, and no open-ended retainers.
- [How We Price](https://1digit.co.uk/how-we-price): Outcome-based pricing with fixed-price diagnostics, milestone-based implementation, and transparent scope management.
- [AI Architecture Framework](https://1digit.co.uk/architecture): TOGAF-aligned framework covering business, data, application, and technology architecture domains for enterprise AI.

## Trust & Compliance

- [Trust & Security](https://1digit.co.uk/trust-security): Enterprise governance, compliance standards (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR), AI risk management, secure SDLC, and audit capabilities.

## Assessment Tools

- [Free AI Readiness Assessment](https://1digit.co.uk/ai-readiness-assessment): Self-service tool evaluating organisational AI readiness across five pillars with instant results and actionable recommendations.

## Insights

- [Insights Hub](https://1digit.co.uk/insights): Published research on AI readiness, architecture, governance, and platform economics for enterprise leaders and technical decision-makers.
